h1: KOO Hotel, Pak Kret — A New, Clean Boutique Hotel Just 4–5 Minutes from IMPACT Arena, Pink Line MRT at the Door
intro: Heading to a concert, trade fair or event at IMPACT Arena or IMPACT Challenger in Muang Thong Thani and want a genuinely fresh, clean hotel without paying Novotel prices? KOO Hotel is the name that keeps showing up in IMPACT-goer recommendations. It's a boutique 3-star that opened in 2023 at 96 Chaengwattana–Pak Kret Soi 35, Nonthaburi — 3.2 km from IMPACT Arena, roughly a 4–5 minute drive — and under 100 metres from the MRT Pink Line at Si Rat station, which now runs a spur directly into Muang Thong Thani (opened 2025). Rooms are decorated in seasonal colour themes with a thoughtful wet/dry bathroom layout; the hotel offers 24-hour check-in, free secure parking and a cute on-site café. Real guest score: 9.2 out of 10 from 473 reviews. Rooms start from approx. ฿1,200–1,400 per night in standard season, rising during big-event weekends.

body.html: KOO Hotel sits at 96 Chaengwattana–Pak Kret Soi 35, Tambon Khlong Klua, in the Pak Kret district of Nonthaburi — a location that punches well above its price for anyone whose trip revolves around IMPACT Muang Thong Thani. IMPACT Arena is 3.2 km away, a 4–5 minute drive; the MRT Pink Line's Si Rat station is right outside the door (under 100 m away), and that line now includes a stop at Muang Thong Thani with a covered Skywalk directly into IMPACT's halls. CentralPlaza Chaengwattana, good for pre-show shopping and dining, is a 400-metre stroll. Don Mueang Airport is about 9 km or 20–25 minutes by car.

The hotel opened in 2023, so everything still feels genuinely fresh. Six room categories run from 19 to 30 sqm: Koo Studio Queen · Koo Deluxe Twin · Koo Deluxe Double · Triple Koo (sleeps three) · Koo Premier (with a sofa) and Koo Suite (with a bathtub). The detail that guests mention most is the bathroom layout — a properly separated wet zone (shower) and dry zone (vanity/toilet) is surprisingly rare in this price bracket and makes getting ready in a pair far less awkward. All rooms come with a Smart TV, mini-fridge, hair dryer, complimentary water and free Wi-Fi. Digital key locks mean you don't have to line up at reception if you arrive late.
"Always the best hotel to stay near Impact Arena — clean rooms, great wet/dry bathroom separation, friendly staff, convenient location. Will definitely be back."

For concert and event visitors the practical strengths stack up quickly: 24-hour check-in means no pressure if the last act runs long; free parking with keycard access and CCTV means driving here and walking back (or taking the MRT) is a relaxed option; and the Koo Koo Cafe on-site covers morning coffee without leaving the building. A 7-Eleven is within 50 metres for late-night supplies. The hotel's co-working space and 30-person meeting room make it useful for corporate groups too.

Honesty requires noting the trade-offs clearly. There is no swimming pool and no breakfast included in standard rates. The 3.2 km gap to IMPACT means you need the MRT or a car — guests who want to roll out of bed and walk to the hall will be better served by ibis Bangkok IMPACT or Novotel Bangkok IMPACT, both inside Muang Thong Thani with a covered Skywalk to the venue (and a correspondingly higher price tag). A minority of reviews flag motorcycle noise from the street, some Koo Suite guests found the bathtub's hot water inconsistent, and early check-in before 14:00 can attract a substantial surcharge.

The score of 9.2 from 473 real reviews — and an Agoda Travelers' Choice 2025 award — tells the broader story. Most guests who stayed here for IMPACT events found the combination of new rooms, clean bathrooms, free parking and the MRT stop outside to be genuinely good value compared with in-venue alternatives. The formula works best if you are comfortable with a short MRT or Grab ride to the event, or if you are driving and want to park free rather than battle for space at the venue itself.

Practical tips drawn from guest feedback: book at least two to three weeks before any big IMPACT event — rooms here sell out fast during motor shows, major concerts and food fairs. If you are a group of three, the Triple Koo at 28 sqm is better value per head than two separate rooms. And if an early arrival is likely, call ahead rather than expect an early check-in at the door; the front desk is responsive, but the extra charge can sting.

honestSummary: KOO Hotel is new, clean and well-priced for the IMPACT event circuit, with a bathroom layout that stands out in this bracket and a location that combines free parking with an MRT stop at the front door. The honest trade-off is that you are 3.2 km from the venue — a short ride, not a walk — and there is no pool or included breakfast.
honestChecks: If you need to walk directly to IMPACT halls without getting in a vehicle — ibis Bangkok IMPACT or Novotel Bangkok IMPACT, both inside Muang Thong Thani with a covered Skywalk to the event halls, will suit you better. Expect to pay noticeably more.

If you book the Koo Suite specifically for the bathtub — a minority of reviews mention inconsistent hot water. Report it immediately to the front desk; staff responsiveness scores are high and the issue is reportedly resolved quickly.

If you plan to arrive before 14:00 check-in time — the early check-in fee can be as high as ฿1,000. The smarter move is to drop luggage at reception, take the MRT to explore or head straight to IMPACT, and return when your room is ready.

tips.title: Use the MRT Pink Line to IMPACT
tips.body: Si Rat station (MRT Pink Line) is under 100 m from the hotel. Ride to Muang Thong Thani station, then walk the covered Skywalk directly into IMPACT. Far cheaper than a taxi late at night.

tips.title: Book Early Before Big IMPACT Events
tips.body: Motor shows, major concerts and trade fairs fill Pak Kret hotels fast. Aim to book two to four weeks out for the best availability and rates.

tips.title: Driving In? Parking Is Free
tips.body: The hotel's secure parking with keycard and CCTV is free for guests. If the event runs past midnight and the MRT has stopped, you can drive back without worry.

tips.title: 24-Hour Check-In — No Rush After the Show
tips.body: Front desk operates around the clock. Coming back at 1 am after the encore is no problem. If you arrive early, drop your bags and head out; no early check-in surcharge applies after 14:00.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — KOO Hotel, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi

faq.q: Where is KOO Hotel and how far is it from IMPACT Arena?
faq.a: KOO Hotel is at 96 Chaengwattana–Pak Kret Soi 35, Tambon Khlong Klua, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi 11120. IMPACT Arena Muang Thong Thani is approximately 3.2 km away — about a 4–5 minute drive or a short MRT ride on the Pink Line from Si Rat station (under 100 m from the hotel) to Muang Thong Thani station.

faq.q: How do I get from KOO Hotel to IMPACT Arena?
faq.a: Two easy options: (1) Drive or take Grab/taxi — 3.2 km, around 4–5 minutes. (2) MRT Pink Line — Si Rat station is under 100 m from the hotel; ride to Muang Thong Thani station, then walk the covered Skywalk directly into the IMPACT complex (MRT Pink Line to Muang Thong Thani opened 2025).

faq.q: What do rooms cost at KOO Hotel?
faq.a: Standard rates start from around ฿1,200–1,400 per night for a Koo Studio Queen (19 sqm). Prices rise to ฿1,800–2,200 or more during major IMPACT events, concerts and public holidays. The Koo Suite with bathtub starts from approximately ฿1,900 in normal season.

faq.q: Is parking free at KOO Hotel?
faq.a: Yes — free parking is provided for hotel guests, secured with a keycard system and 24-hour CCTV. A useful feature if you are driving to IMPACT events, especially when returning late at night.

faq.q: Does KOO Hotel have a pool or breakfast included?
faq.a: No swimming pool. Breakfast is not included in standard room rates (add-on packages may be available). The Koo Koo Cafe in the lobby serves coffee and light food, and a 7-Eleven is about 50 m from the hotel.

faq.q: Who is KOO Hotel best for?
faq.a: Best for concert-goers, trade fair visitors and event attendees at IMPACT Muang Thong Thani who want a clean, new hotel under ฿1,500–2,000 per night. Also well suited to guests who drive to events and want free secure parking. Less suitable if you need to walk directly to IMPACT halls without taking a vehicle — for that, ibis Bangkok IMPACT or Novotel Bangkok IMPACT (both inside Muang Thong Thani with a Skywalk) are better options.
